---openapi registrationDate---
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When
            supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows registering an owner that shares a household
            (same last name and address) with an existing owner, bypassing the
            household-duplicate rejection. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner

=== InvalidOwnerPostcodeException ===
package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation;

/**
 * Thrown by {@code ValidateOwnerPostcode} when a create/update owner request supplies a
 * postcode that is either malformed (not exactly 4 digits) or out of the valid range for
 * the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
 * known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Handled by
 * {@link InvalidOwnerPostcodeExceptionHandler}, which responds 400.
 */
public class InvalidOwnerPostcodeException extends Exception {

    public InvalidOwnerPostcodeException(String postcode, String city) {
        super("Invalid postcode '" + postcode + "' for city: " + city);
    }
}
